traps: GET /Home/Search returns EMPTY HEADERS when 66 rows exist — the grid is POST /Home/SearchTableV2.
taxYear is SILENTLY IGNORED on SearchTableV2, producing a fake flat ownership history that reads as proof of a long hold. Use /Home/PropertyRoll (2022+ only) for any year-over-year claim.

/Home/Sales is empty for ALL parcels — TX is non-disclosure. The recorded deed of trust gives the loan amount, hence an LTV bracket, and that is the only price signal. Never infer ownership from lending alone.

This is the Fort Stockton negative-control county: Tracerfy trace_lookup on a park address returns an occupant with property_owner:true while the CAD roll names an out-of-state LLC. The anchor is the verdict (acceptance test 22).
